description: Returns the currencies supported by CurrencyFreaks: 1000+ fiat currencies, cryptocurrencies, and precious metals (XAU gold, XAG silver, XPT platinum, XPD palladium). Use it to find a currency code before calling rate or conversion tools. No API key needed. By default returns a compact code → name map. Pass 'search' to filter by code, name, or country (e.g. 'rupee', 'PK', 'bitcoin'). Pass detailed=true for country, status (AVAILABLE/DEPRECATED), and the availableFrom/availableUntil date range of historical data per currency — combine with 'search' because the full detailed catalogue is very large.

detailed.description: Return full details per currency (country, status, historical availability range, icon). Default false.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against currency code, name, or (with detailed=true) country name.

name: list_currencies
title: List supported currencies
